mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces risk-free rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the average 20-day forward return is negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates a weakening labor market that often precedes a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, the average 20-day forward return is positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 500 thousand units and retail sales below 330,000 million dollars indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 500 and RSAFS < 330000, the average 20-day forward return is positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary regime characterized by CPI index below 220 and federal funds rate below 0.5%, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to stable inflation and accommodative policy.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL < 220 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, the average 20-day forward return is negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90.0 (2017=100) indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90.0, the average 60-day forward return is positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500 thousand units indicates a weakening housing market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market sentiment effects.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 500, the average 5-day forward return is positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index value below 210.0 (indicating low inflation) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to stable economic conditions.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL < 210.0, the average 60-day forward return is negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reactions to economic weakness.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, the average 5-day forward return is positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
